set system root-authentication plain-tex.explanation: Sets the authentication method for root users as an explicit password.

set system ports console speed 4800.explanation: Configure the port rate of the console port.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.explanation: Porter rate, in bits per second.

set system ports console data-bits 6.explanation: Configure data slots at the console port.

set system ports console parity even.command: set system ports console parity even
set system ports console parity even.explanation: Configure the occasional verification of the console port.

parameters.name: parity
parameters.explanation: The odd check method, with the optional values none, even, odd.

set system ports console stop-bits 2.explanation: Configures the stop of the console port.

set system ports console session idle-ti.template: set system ports console session idle-timeout [parameter1]
set system ports console session idle-ti.command: set system ports console session idle-timeout 30
set system ports console session idle-ti.explanation: Configures the free hours of the Console session.

set system ports console session length.template: set system ports console session length [parameter1]
set system ports console session length.command: set system ports console session length 30
set system ports console session length.explanation: Configure the length of the console session.

set system login user root.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class super-user.explanation: Configure the type of system login user.
